text:
support_jordan: Hey team — customer `acme-pro` reported their trial credits dropped ~75k overnight. They only use embeddings + rerank. Can someone help triage? :eyes:
eng_priya: Thanks Jordan. Do we have the tenant id and a sample request id?
support_jordan: tenant=acme-pro, example req id from logs `req_2026-03-15_02:14:07`. They say it was a scheduled backfill job.
eng_sam: Poked the ingestion logs — I see a flood of POST /v1/embeddings from our bg-worker pool around 02:10-02:40. Many 500s followed by immediate retries. Looks like the worker retried without exponential backoff and no idempotency key. Snippet:
```\nPOST /v1/embeddings 500 req=req_2026-03-15_02:14:07 worker=ingest-42\nPOST /v1/embeddings 500 req=req_2026-03-15_02:14:07 worker=ingest-42 retry=1\nPOST /v1/embeddings 200 req=req_2026-03-15_02:14:07 worker=ingest-42\n```\ningest-bot: automated note: job `nightly-backfill-2026-03-15` started 02:05 UTC, concurrency=48, retry_policy=immediate (legacy flag).
eng_priya: Ah — retry_policy=immediate is the problem. That policy was supposed to be migrated away last quarter. If the worker doesn't send an idempotency-key, retries create fresh usage.
ops_ryan: I just disabled the scheduled backfill for acme-pro and flipped the global legacy retry flag to conservative backoff. New runs will pause until we confirm fix.
support_jordan: Thanks. Can billing review credits consumed and start a refund? This is a trial customer.
billing_maya: On it. I'm pulling the per-tenant token/embedding counts now. If confirmed, we'll issue a one-time credit equal to the overage and top up the trial to original amount. ETA 30m.
eng_sam: Root cause hypothesis: nightly backfill consumer used `retry_policy=immediate` + omitted idempotency header, plus temporary 500s from model host. That caused N duplicate successful calls. Fix options:
- require idempotency-key in backfill client (reject or attach deterministic key)
- change default retry_policy to exponential backoff and jitter
- server-side dedupe for embeddings by request fingerprint for 10s window
eng_priya: Short-term patch: add automatic client-side idempotency header in our worker library (0.1.3) and deploy to ingestion fleet. Medium-term: server-side request fingerprinting.
support_jordan: Customer update drafted: "We found a scheduled backfill used immediate retries during transient errors, resulting in duplicate embedding calls. We're pausing the job, issuing credits, and pushing a patch to prevent repeats." Want me to send?
billing_maya: Refund prepared: 74,812 credits refunded to account, plus trial top-up of 25k credits. I added a note: "reason: duplicate embedding retries during nightly backfill".
eng_sam: Deployed client patch to ingestion workers (canary on 6 hosts) that attaches deterministic idempotency-key = `backfill:<job_id>:<doc_id>`. Rolling out to 48 hosts now.
ops_ryan: Canary looks good, CPU and network normal. No new retry storms.
eng_priya: I'll open a follow-up ticket for server-side dedupe and a telemetry alert when retry counts > 10% of requests in a window.
support_jordan: Sent the customer the drafted message, they replied :thumbsup: and asked for confirmation when credits land.
billing_maya: Credits applied. Customer should see it in UI. I'll close the billing ticket after confirmation.
support_jordan: Closing loop here: root cause = legacy immediate retry policy + missing idempotency keys during scheduled backfill. Remediation = job paused, worker lib patch + rollout, billing refund, follow-up server dedupe ticket. Action items assigned to eng_priya + eng_sam.
eng_priya: assigning ticket INF-5609 for server dedupe + alerting.
eng_sam: I'll file a postmortem doc and include reproducer steps + safe rollout plan.
support_jordan: thanks everyone. Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
